prompts.title: Orders and settlement
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished NEXG merchant workspace desktop screen, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Screen picture only, no browser chrome, device, photograph of a screen, annotations, extra panels outside the application, or collage. Match the established portal: charcoal left sidebar about 240px, gold NEXG wordmark, warm cream canvas #f6f3ec, white surfaces with fine warm gray borders and 12px corners, black Manrope-like clean sans-serif, consistent fine outline icons. Readable body text, aligned tabular amounts. Sidebar EXACT order Home, Work, Offerings, Availability, Business, Money, Promotions, Insights, Settings. Highlight Money with a gold accent and darker pill. Compact white top bar: Merchant workspace, Sample preview badge, Choose sample state, location selector, bell, Help, account circle. This is clearly sample data. A compact Money heading and short subtitle, scoped source/date controls, tabs, four relevant summary tiles, then a large readable working table with SIX rows and an adjacent detail inspector of roughly 350px. Fit the entire screen into one viewport with all table rows and the inspector's main actions visible. Give the table the main area; do not let headings, whitespace or decorative charts squeeze it. Information dense but calm; clear grouping and useful spacing. Text plus icons for statuses, gold only for navigation/primary action, restrained amber for uncertainty, red for overdue, pale blue selected row. No invented tax rates, no fictional earned/profit balance, no pie/donut graphs, no withdrawal button. Do not render prompt instructions as text. Render the requested amounts and status distinctions faithfully. SCREEN 1. Merchant Nairobi Collective, location Westlands, initials NC. Title Money; subtitle Understand your sales and settlement. Scope line: 1–3 Nov 2026 · NEXG-collected only · KES · Sample 09:40 EAT. Tabs Overview (active), Transactions, Payouts, Statements. Four summary tiles: Posted sales KES 200,000; Confirmed sales refunds KES 10,000; Posted fees KES 8,000; Net payable in period KES 182,000. Small subtitle clarifies figures are Finance statement values for the selected period. Main left table titled Money activity; search and type filter are compact. Columns Reference, Work, Type, Amount, Status. Six rows exactly: TX-6112 / Order #4612 / Sale / +24,800 / Paid; TX-6113 / Order #4613 / Sale / +18,000 / Paid; TX-6114 / Order #4614 / Sale / +12,200 / Paid; TX-6115 / Order #4598 / Refund / −4,000 / Confirmed; TX-6116 / Statement fee / Fee / −1,200 / Posted; TX-6117 / Order #4615 / Sale / +9,600 / Paid. Use KES column header so currency is unambiguous. Caption 6 of 36 records; View all transactions. Right inspector titled Settlement as of 3 Nov, small badge Eligible. Large Ready for payout KES 30,000. Explain exact calculation in five aligned rows Opening payable +20,000; Period net payable +182,000; Confirmed payout −150,000; Settlement reserve −22,000; Eligible balance 30,000. Short note Settlement includes opening balances; it is separate from this period's sales. Masked destination Bank account ••••4821. Gold primary button View payout details; secondary View statement. Do not label ready as received or sent. Footer links Definitions, Source details, Export. All figures are illustrative owner-confirmed sample statement amounts; no formula or rate is universal.

Right inspector Refund OP-6209, amber icon and label Result being checked. Asset Toyota RAV4 · RAV4-01, work RNT-2070. Compact note Work confirms vehicle returned. Money result is separate. Aligned lines Deposit collected 20,000; Charge allocation (posted) 2,000; Refund requested 18,000; Refund confirmed 0. Amber box Recorded return obligation remains KES 18,000 until the source confirms the result. Gold button Check refund status. Gray disabled button Submit another refund. Link Open condition case. Small caption The KES 2,000 allocation was confirmed and posted by Finance; approval alone would not reduce security. Footer Security is customer money, excluded from rental sales and payout eligibility. Keep all six rows, complete amounts, unknown-operation warning and actions visible. No automatic security release, no green refunded success for the unknown18,000.
